name: GraphRAG-QA open-domain (Wikipedia) demo questions
description: Multi-hop questions for Mode B. The system retrieves live Wikipedia articles (cached after the first run), so results depend on the current article text. Expected answers were written by hand from well-known facts; gold_articles name the Wikipedia articles that contain the supporting facts.

questions.question: In which city was the co-founder and CEO of DeepMind born?
Which university did the director of the film Inception study at?
Which river flows through the city where the Brandenburg Gate is located?
In which year was the university where Alan Turing earned his PhD founded?
Which country is the birthplace of the physicist who developed the theory of general relativity?
